Prospect summary:
- EU-based payment processor, licenses across 7 EU markets. Heavily regulated (PSP + local AML rules).
- Looking for inference platform to power fraud scoring (low-latency per-transaction), embeddings for merchant/customer search, and a support chat assistant.
- Target latency: 50-150ms p95 for fraud model scoring (per-transaction pipeline). Throughput: bursty peaks ~2k TPS during promotions. Cost-sensitive but willing to pay for guaranteed region isolation.
- Model preferences: open weights preferred; quantization OK; need control of model versions and ability to fallback to smaller models for hot paths.
- Security: absolute requirement for EU-only data residency (no data replication outside EU), SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration. Legal required written guarantee of region isolation.
